$comment: The reference run of the seeded set. Every check this suite makes passes on it, which is what makes
it the case every other seeded case is a one-edit mutation of: the derivation of each of those says
what its edit changed and nothing else has to be re-derived.
The document is CONSTRUCTED. It reports the five risks the epic supports, one per category the epic
grounds, scores each on the workflow's own scale, files each under the band its score falls in, and
links each from a coverage row at a level the fixture admits.
derivation: Five risk rows, ids R-001 through R-005, so wellFormedIds is 5 and no id repeats.
Categories SEC, DATA, TECH, PERF and OPS are all among the six, so validCategories is 5.
Scale and arithmetic: 2x3=6, 3x3=9, 3x2=6, 2x2=4, 1x2=2. Every factor is in 1..3, so inScale is 5 and
the arithmetic denominator is 5; every stated score is the product, so arithmeticOk is 5.
Bands: 6, 9 and 6 sit under Score >=6; 4 sits under Score 3-4; 2 sits under Score 1-2. All five rows
sit under a heading that declares a range, so banded is 5 and bandOk is 5.
Risk links: five coverage rows each name one declared id, so 5 of 5 resolve.
Grounding: each of the five descriptions carries both token groups of the material risk it names, in a
category that risk admits, so matched is 5 of 5 and missed is empty. No unmatched row matches any
ruled-out entry, so ungrounded is empty.
Coverage: R-001 at Integration (admitted Unit, Integration, E2E), R-002 at E2E (API, Integration, E2E),
R-003 at Unit (Unit, Integration, API), R-004 at API (API, Integration, E2E), R-005 at E2E (E2E,
Integration, Component). Five evaluated, five satisfied.
Ordering: ranks are sec 1, data 2, tech 3, perf 4, ops 4, which gives nine strictly ordered pairs.
Priorities are sec P0, data P0, tech P1, perf P2, ops P2. Every pair has the more severe risk at a
priority at least as strong as the less severe one, so all nine resolve and all nine pass.
